paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS sets 95% CL exclusion limits on ALP coupling g_agamma vs ALP mass (5-90 GeV) via gamma-gamma -> a -> gamma-gamma in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma = 1/Lambda). However, the numerical limit values for the g_agamma vs m_a plane are only shown in Fig. 7, with no extractable tabulated values in the provided text. The cross-section limits are described qualitatively (1500-20 nb over 5-90 GeV) but not as digitized (mass, coupling) pairs. This is a collider bound, so no DM density applies. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionPhoton (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
